title: Dating apps test AI matchmaking instead of endless swiping
friendlyTitle: Some dating apps now use AI instead of swiping
summary: A new group of dating apps, including Ditto, is replacing large swipe queues with AI-led introductions based on conversations and stated preferences. The approach promises fewer, more deliberate matches, while asking users to share unusually personal data with an algorithm.
friendlySummary: New dating apps talk with users and use AI to suggest a smaller number of possible matches.
whyItMatters: AI is starting to mediate intimate choices, not just office tasks. Anyone trying these services should examine how conversation data is stored, whether profiles can be deleted and how much control the system has over introductions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may save time, but it requires sharing personal information. Check the app’s privacy and deletion rules first.
